title: Leveraging Deep Learning, Grid Search, and Bayesian Networks to Predict Distant Recurrence of Breast Cancer.
summary: Bayesian-network MBIL risk-factor selection followed by deep feed-forward neural models and randomized grid search for 5/10/15-year breast cancer metastasis; 80/20 validation split and five-fold CV, with held-out AUCs reported (5-year risk-factor model .792 vs all-feature .734). Existing datasets; horizon and recurrence endpoint limit interpretation.
